validated_offline: frozen bootstrap Issue body hashes and heading-to-section mappings
record shape and internal cross-reference integrity
K10 and K11 minimal-partial-offline status vocabulary
not_validated_offline: GitHub API object existence or native type
current GitHub Issue body equality after the recorded observation
plan-comment authorship, edit history, or chronology
Actions run or job URL association with the declared head SHA
live labels or current-attempt ritual enforcement
real Codex execution or runtime-profile match
live runtime receipt existence, freshness, or acceptance
full K10, K11, runtime, or cross-surface parity

template.name: Epic
template.description: Define a durable Epic in the canonical Issue graph.
template.title: [Epic]

fields.label: Goal
fields.description: State the durable outcome and why it matters.
fields.placeholder: Describe one durable repository outcome.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: List the repository outcomes included in this Epic.
fields.placeholder: One scoped outcome per line.

fields.label: Non-goals
fields.description: List explicit exclusions. Use None only when there are no exclusions.
fields.placeholder: One exclusion per line, or None.

fields.label: Task graph
fields.description: List same-repository Task Issue URLs and each Task's explicit dependencies.
fields.placeholder: Task URL -> None, or Task URL -> dependency Task URL(s).

fields.label: Dependency policy
fields.description: Describe sequencing, blocked-by rules, and rolling-wave boundaries.
fields.placeholder: State how the graph may change and when human judgment is required.

fields.label: Acceptance criteria
fields.description: Provide uniquely identified, testable criteria.
fields.placeholder: AC-01: verifiable outcome.

fields.label: Evidence requirements
fields.description: Define current-head target-side evidence required for acceptance.
fields.placeholder: Name commands, checks, receipts, and required bindings.

fields.label: Planning owner
fields.description: Name the accountable owner or repository role.
fields.placeholder: Repository owner

fields.label: Control policy
fields.description: State risk gates, scope-change gates, and final acceptance authority.
fields.placeholder: Describe Human-on-the-Loop boundaries and escalation triggers.

template.name: Task
template.description: Define one bounded Task under an Epic Issue.
template.title: [Task]

fields.label: Objective
fields.description: State one bounded Task outcome.
fields.placeholder: Describe the result this Task must produce.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: List included work and explicit exclusions.
fields.placeholder: Included paths and behavior; then out-of-scope work.

fields.label: Acceptance criteria
fields.description: Provide uniquely identified, deterministic criteria.
fields.placeholder: AC-01: verifiable outcome.

fields.label: Parent Epic Issue URL
fields.description: Use one canonical same-repository Epic Issue URL.
fields.placeholder: https://github.com/mochan-tk/agentic-dev-kit-for-codex/issues/2

fields.label: Dependencies
fields.description: Use None or list same-repository Task Issue URLs.
fields.placeholder: None, or one Task Issue URL per line.

fields.label: References
fields.description: List durable same-repository references. Use None when empty.
fields.placeholder: One Issue, pull request, commit, or comment URL per line, or None.

fields.label: Owned paths
fields.description: List normalized exact paths or terminal /** patterns with Git modes; ownership must not overlap.
fields.placeholder: 100644 path/to/file, one entry per line.

fields.label: Risk tier
fields.description: Select the reviewed A-D risk classification.

fields.label: Risk rationale
fields.description: Explain why the selected tier applies.
fields.placeholder: State concrete impact and reversibility.

fields.label: Risk constraints
fields.description: List required gates and prohibited operations.
fields.placeholder: One constraint per line.

fields.label: Verification commands
fields.description: List deterministic commands that must run against the current head.
fields.placeholder: One exact command per line.

fields.label: Evidence requirements
fields.description: State required fields, result semantics, URLs, and current-head bindings.
fields.placeholder: Name every acceptance receipt and binding.

fields.label: Routing
fields.description: Declare supervisor, writer topology, and escalation route.
fields.placeholder: Name responsibility and stop conditions without claiming identity guarantees.

fields.label: Execution
fields.description: State branch, worktree, pull-request boundary, and approved actuators.
fields.placeholder: Describe the bounded execution plan.

fields.label: Completion conditions
fields.description: State Task completion conditions and the repository-level incomplete boundary.
fields.placeholder: List Task gates and preserve release_blocked until the completion PR.

fields.label: Relationships
fields.description: List the Epic, primary pull request when known, and related durable records.
fields.placeholder: Use canonical same-repository URLs or None where allowed.

fields.label: Task execution envelope reference (optional and opaque)
fields.description: Optional linkage only. Supply the field-specific opaque-ref/v1 value required by the machine contract. Only the locator grammar is parsed. The referenced target is neither resolved nor dereferenced, and the value proves neither target validity nor target freshness; it provides no evidence of implementation, execution, or acceptance.
fields.placeholder: Use opaque-ref/v1 with this field's required kind, sha256, and 64 lowercase hex characters, or leave blank.

fields.label: Loop event reference (optional and opaque)
fields.description: Optional linkage only. Supply the field-specific opaque-ref/v1 value required by the machine contract. Only the locator grammar is parsed. The referenced target is neither resolved nor dereferenced, and the value proves neither target validity nor target freshness; it provides no evidence of implementation, execution, or acceptance.
fields.placeholder: Use opaque-ref/v1 with this field's required kind, sha256, and 64 lowercase hex characters, or leave blank.

fields.label: Task relationship
fields.description: Enter exactly Closes or Refs followed by one canonical same-repository Task Issue URL; a bare URL is invalid.
fields.placeholder: Closes or Refs followed by one canonical same-repository Task Issue URL; no default.

fields.label: Plan comment URL
fields.description: A concrete same-Task issuecomment URL; offline validation does not prove existence, authorship, edit history, or chronology.
fields.placeholder: Enter one concrete issuecomment URL belonging to the primary Task.

fields.label: Summary
fields.description: Summarize the durable outcome.
fields.placeholder: Describe what changed and why.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: List changed surfaces and explicit exclusions.
fields.placeholder: One included or excluded surface per line.

fields.label: Exact head SHA
fields.description: Bind evidence to the exact 40-character lowercase pull-request head SHA.
fields.placeholder: Enter the exact 40-character lowercase pull-request head SHA.

fields.label: Evidence
fields.description: For every row provide ID, Task criterion ID, check, result, evidence URL, head SHA, and observed-at timestamp. Commit/check URLs are SHA-bound; Actions URL-to-head association is not proven offline.
fields.placeholder:
| ID | Criterion ID | Check | Result | Evidence URL | Head SHA | Observed at |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

fields.label: Risks
fields.description: List remaining risks. Use None only when no risk remains.
fields.placeholder: One risk per line, or None.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.description: State unimplemented or unverified boundaries without overclaiming.
fields.placeholder: One limitation per line, or None.

fields.label: Deferred evidence
fields.description: Use None, or provide ID, Task criterion ID, reason, owner, and same-repository follow-up Issue URL for every deferred item.
fields.placeholder:
None, or use: | ID | Criterion ID | Reason | Owner | Follow-up Issue URL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
